motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum smooth scrolling active across full document
motion_and_interactions.cursor: Custom dual-ring magnetic cursor expanding on buttons and showing 'EXPLORE' on 3D canvas hover
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered text reveal on initial page mount
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow organic editorial text drift with low-contrast muted palette (#121212 / #E2DFD8)
motion_and_interactions.particle_disassembly: Interactive Canvas/Three.js 3D Oversized Tee disassembling into fabric particles on scroll
motion_and_interactions.3d_phone: Interactive 3D rotated phone showcase with tab switcher for 6 app screens (Home, Return, Impact, Journey, Rewards, Drop)

key_sections.title: 01 Hero
key_sections.description: 3D oversized tee with mouse parallax, scroll disassembly into fabric particles, kinetic brand statement, and immediate waitlist CTA.

key_sections.title: 02 Style
key_sections.description: Tactile technical spec sheet: 240 GSM, 100% combed cotton, relaxed drop shoulder, high-density embroidery, custom ribbing.

key_sections.title: 03 The Problem
key_sections.description: Dark editorial chapter: 'What happens when you're done with it?' High contrast dark surface detailing linear waste vs circular loop.

key_sections.title: 04 The Take-Back
key_sections.description: Interactive discount counter (0 to 4 garments), live price calculator (₹999 down to ₹799 max 20% off), explicit rule breakdown.

key_sections.title: 05 Three Paths
key_sections.description: Interactive branching visual: Rewear -> Revamp -> Recycle connected via an animated continuous circular ribbon loop.

key_sections.title: 06 Impact
key_sections.description: Traceable Impact Ledger starting at 0 ('We're starting with 50'), glass dashboard preview card clearly labelled DEMO.

key_sections.title: 07 Drop 001
key_sections.description: Limited pilot collection showcase (50 pieces total, 3 designs: Minimal, Statement, Circular @ ₹999 each) with tactile detail zoom.

key_sections.title: 08 The App
key_sections.description: 3D phone interactive frame with 6 simulated screens. App store buttons open 'Coming Soon' modal with email waitlist capture.

key_sections.title: 09 Final CTA
key_sections.description: Deep forest green anchor block with massive typography 'BECOME PART OF THE LOOP' and instant waitlist form.

key_sections.title: 10 Footer
key_sections.description: Minimal high-fashion footer with massive kinetic logo, trademark specs, manifest chapter anchors, and social links.

copy_rules.mandatory_takeback_text: Bring back clothes you no longer want when you buy from Revamped. Get 5% off for every garment you contribute. Up to 4 garments. Maximum 20% off.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive button, link, tab, input, modal trigger, slider, and counter MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-waitlist-button', data-testid='takeback-slider', data-testid='coming-soon-email-input').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_headers: Header MUST use glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F5F3EF]/80 with a 1px solid border bottom. Never fully transparent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.sonner_toast: Use sonner toast for waitlist submissions and copy actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.fonts: Import Syne, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Mono from Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
